title: naive.config.json
description: A venture's overrides to Naive's defaults, at the venture root (P-2, like next.config.js): the gate (fail-closed routes, rules over the router's path patterns, which package rules it imports), function owners, check settings (P-7, like eslint.config.mjs), thresholds, which System 1 questions run, pinned package versions (U-4) and how strictly the acting role is checked (M-18). Every field is optional; a missing one keeps the default in packages/naive/src/engine/naive-config.mjs. node packages/naive/src/checks/check-config.mjs <venture dir> checks it.

traces.description: Traces in the venture's files (EE-121): true writes one span per step of an agent run to traces/<session>.jsonl, hash-chained and linked from provenance. content keeps inputs and outputs too, redacted; off by default because a trace is internal. Off by default.

beta.description: The plugin beta's gate (packages/naive/src/engine/beta-gate.mjs): capabilities in beta/capabilities.json unlock in order, each after checkpoint feedback. Off by default.

jev.description: Opt-in for routing feedback through Jev: send lets feedback text leave the machine, and counts only with set_by naming the person who turned it on. A TYPESAFE_API_KEY alone sends nothing.

telemetry.description: Usage telemetry (packages/naive/src/engine/telemetry.mjs, packages/naive/src/records/telemetry.schema.json), opt-in: enabled writes events to .naive/telemetry.jsonl; send lets them leave the machine, and counts only with set_by naming the person who turned it on.

gate.description: The venture's one gate (X-5). It runs before every write and never calls a model (X-4).

fail_closed.description: Routes whose agent writes are always drafts; each covers that route and every route under it (X-3)

rules.description: Rules that read the write itself: who writes it, its route, its confidence (X-1, X-2, X-6)

packages.description: Which packages' gate rules the gate imports from their package definitions (X-5): true for all (the default), false for none, or a map of package name to false to leave one out

variants.description: Keep differing agent drafts of one record side by side, with one decision for the founder, on every held route (X-2). A rule can turn this on for its routes alone

owners.description: Function owners: function (department) id to the role that owns it, so a write routed to its owner reaches the right person (X-2)

checks.description: Check settings (P-7): which of a route's checks are off, and which only warn

off.description: Checks that do not run, by path (packages/naive/src/checks/check-telos.mjs)

warn.description: Checks that run but do not fail the route's check

investors_lint.description: Investors lint (investors/lint). Each rule is fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed, which makes that rule's findings fail the run.

thresholds.description: Thresholds by name: confidence (the gate's confidence routing), idea-map (when a System 1 answer becomes a tag)

questions.description: Which System 1 questions run, by framework (idea-map): off lists question kinds, the part of a question key before the colon (exists, dept.legal, rec.*)

packages.description: Pinned package versions (U-4): package name to the version the venture uses. A write to a pinned package whose installed version differs is refused until the pin or the install changes. A pin is a version string, or { version, early, channel } as naive upgrade writes it (U-5)

acting.description: How the acting role is checked on every action (M-18)

unknown_roles.description: A role id the team plan does not list: allow (the default, it may reach every route) or refuse

naive.description: The framework version the venture is on, and its channel (EE-076, written by naive upgrade)

kits.description: Mentura kits whose automations this venture turns on

publish_lint.description: The publish lint (packages/naive/src/engine/publish-lint.mjs): each rule off, warn or error, the marks to flag, and findings a person waived

publish_build.description: The publish build (packages/naive/src/functions/marketing-and-sales/marketing/publish-build.mjs): the venture's channels and the folder they build into. Naive ships no channel; the venture or its app names each one

out.description: The default output folder, relative to the venture folder (default .release/publish-build)

outputs.description: The files the channel writes, relative to the output folder

builders.description: Scripts run in order with node, each relative to the venture folder or absolute

triggers.description: What starts the next step on an event (packages/naive/src/router/orchestration/triggers.mjs)

listeners.description: The venture's own signal listeners (signal library design): each joins a signal type to one consumer with that consumer's criterion. A listener here replaces any listener of the same id from a package, a frame or a kit. packages/naive/src/engine/signals.ts merges them and naive signals pull evaluates them

listeners_off.description: Listener ids turned off, from any of the four places listeners come from

product_lint.description: Per-rule mode for the product lint (packages/naive/src/checks/lint-product.mjs, route product/lint). A rule stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed.

diagnose.description: naive diagnose --if-due: a full diagnosis runs only when the founder's transcripts since the cursor reach threshold estimated tokens (characters / 4), or a new session is older than stale_hours

premise_lint.description: The premise-attack linter (packages/naive/src/checks/premise-lint.mjs): each rule, one per aspect, is off, warn (the default) or error

money_lint.description: Per-rule mode for the money lint (packages/naive/src/checks/lint-money.mjs, route money/lint). A rule stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed.

customers_lint.description: Customers lint (customers/lint). Per rule, mode fail-closed makes that rule's findings exit 1. The default is fail-open.

validation_lint.description: Per-rule mode for the validation lint (packages/naive/src/checks/lint-validation.mjs, route validation/lint). A rule stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed.

finance_lint.description: finance/lint (packages/naive/src/checks/lint-finance.mjs). Each rule warns and stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed, which makes its findings exit 1.

legal_lint.description: Per-rule mode for the legal lint (packages/naive/src/checks/lint-legal.mjs, route legal/lint). A rule stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed.

foundation_lint.description: Foundation lint (foundation/lint): per-rule mode overrides. A rule stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed.

people_lint.description: Per-rule mode for the people lint (packages/naive/src/checks/lint-people.mjs, route people/lint). A rule stays fail-open unless its mode is fail-closed.

routes.description: The routes the rule covers, in the router's own path patterns (X-6): a route (validation/pricing), an [id] segment (money/[id]), * for one segment and ** for any depth (validation/**, which covers validation too)

actors.description: Who it applies to; default agents only

roles.description: Team-plan roles it applies to; default every role

confidence_below.description: Applies when the write carries a confidence score below this number, or below the named threshold. The score is computed before the write; a write with no score never matches

exists.description: Applies only when the record already exists (true) or does not yet (false)

then.description: draft: hold it as a draft; owner: hold it as a draft sent to the function owner; refuse: do not write it

owner.description: The owner a routed write goes to; default the function owner in owners, else the record's decision-class owner, else founder

variants.description: Keep differing drafts side by side under one decision (X-2)
